description: Implementation of LED control functionalities including initialization, state retrieval, setting, and mapping between internal and external representations, with platform-specific initialization and logging.

classes.name: LEDControlImplementation
classes.description: Implements LED control interface, manages platform initialization, state retrieval, and setting, with support for supported states caching and mapping functions.

classes.name: UpdateSupportedLEDStatesJob
classes.description: A dispatch job class that updates the supported LED states by querying the platform, used within the constructor of LEDControlImplementation.

methods.name: mapFromLEDControlStateToDsFPDLedState
methods.description: Maps internal LEDControlState enum to platform-specific dsFPDLedState_t.

methods.name: mapFromDsFPDLedStateToLEDControlState
methods.description: Maps platform-specific dsFPDLedState_t to internal LEDControlState enum.

methods.name: LEDControlStateToString
methods.description: Converts LEDControlState enum to string representation.

methods.name: getCoreErrorFromDSError
methods.description: Converts dsError_t error codes to Core::hresult.

methods.name: GetSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Retrieves supported LED states from platform, returns as string iterator.

methods.name: GetLEDState
methods.description: Retrieves current LED state from platform.

methods.name: SetLEDState
methods.description: Sets the LED to a specified state if supported.
